metadata.description: Verified external emission factors structured with explicit verification status (VERIFIED_PRIMARY, VERIFIED_SECONDARY, INTERNATIONAL_REFERENCE, NOT_VERIFIED), gas basis (CO2 vs CO2e), and India-First architecture.
metadata.policy: Indian factors are classified as INDIA_PRIMARY. International factors are classified as INTERNATIONAL_REFERENCE with exact national geographic scopes (UK, USA). Unverified factors (NOT_VERIFIED) are rejected.

factors.source: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Ministry of Power, Government of India
factors.source_title: CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, User Guide Version 22.0
factors.methodology: CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector (Weighted Average Grid Emission Factor - CO2 only)
factors.system_boundary: Generation stack emissions / net grid generation. Excludes T&D line losses.
factors.limitations: Applies to Indian national grid electricity consumption. CO2 direct emission factor; does not include minor CH4/N2O or transmission line losses.

factors.source: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ) / DEFRA
factors.source_title: Government Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2023
factors.methodology: UK GHG Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2023 (Material Use - Primary Steel)
factors.system_boundary: Cradle-to-gate primary steel production in the UK.
factors.limitations: Cradle-to-gate emissions for primary blast furnace steel production in the UK. NOT an Indian baseline factor.

factors.source: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ) / DEFRA
factors.source_title: Government Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2023
factors.methodology: UK GHG Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2023 (Material Use - Closed-loop Recycled Steel)
factors.system_boundary: Secondary scrap processing and EAF remelting in the UK.
factors.limitations: Emissions associated with secondary steel scrap processing and electric arc furnace remelting in the UK. NOT an Indian baseline factor.

factors.source: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ) / DEFRA
factors.source_title: Government Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2023
factors.methodology: UK GHG Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2023 (Freighting Goods - All HGV Diesel)
factors.system_boundary: Tank-to-wheel and well-to-tank Scope 3 freight transport in the UK.
factors.limitations: Average emissions per tonne-km for heavy goods vehicles operating on diesel in the UK. NOT an Indian baseline factor.

factors.source_title: GHG Emission Factors Hub & Waste Reduction Model (WARM) v15
factors.methodology: US EPA Waste Reduction Model (WARM) v15 / GHG Emission Factors Hub
factors.system_boundary: Cradle-to-gate primary aluminum smelting in the USA.
factors.limitations: Cradle-to-gate primary aluminum smelting and refining in the USA. NOT an Indian baseline factor.

factors.source_title: GHG Emission Factors Hub & Waste Reduction Model (WARM) v15
factors.methodology: US EPA Waste Reduction Model (WARM) v15 / GHG Emission Factors Hub
factors.system_boundary: Secondary scrap collection, sorting, and remelting in the USA.
factors.limitations: Secondary aluminum scrap collection, sorting, and re-smelting emissions in the USA. NOT an Indian baseline factor.
